limitations: The available browser control API exposes no native two-contact touchscreen gesture; physical pinch interaction on iOS/Android was not claimed. The 15 automated gesture cases exercise two-contact pointer sequences, lifting order, cancellation, clamp reversal, and separation from taps. Eight camera cases cover persistence, anchor invariance, scene changes, battle focus and automatic reset.
Production publication is established separately by the native Sites deployment receipt; this receipt covers the managed preview.
